name: maplibrex-assets
description: Assets for MaplibreX - MapLibre GL JS components for Phoenix LiveView

comments.peerDependencies: These are provided by the host Phoenix application. MaplibreX marks them external at build time so the published bundle never ships a second copy of MapLibre GL.
comments.peerDependenciesMeta: The @deck.gl/* packages are only needed if the application uses the <.deckgl_layer> component; they are lazy-loaded at runtime.
comments.devDependencies: Installed only to type-check and bundle the library itself. Applications consuming MaplibreX never install this package.
comments.maplibre-gl: maplibre-gl v6 is supported for every component except <.deckgl_layer>: @deck.gl/mapbox still reads the internal map.transform that v6 removed. Pin maplibre-gl to ^5.0.0 if you use deck.gl layers.
